An error about the gym not being online

Card "This works in your own gym"
Body ends "The demo gym is made-up data kept only on this page, so this part is switched off here."
Button "Back to Today"

An endless spinner
A raw error such as "Could not find the function"

user_sees: The Today screen of the sample gym
must_not: Leaving the demo
